**1:** Both sections cover the ways to add multimodal capability, the tool-wrapping code (matching the notebook), agent construction, the test question, and the final answer ('gray tabby', matching). The reasoning trace here is described entirely in prose with no actual execution/tool-call notation shown at all -- the most complete replacement of a shown trace with a described one found this session -- but the substantive idea (the agent searches, retrieves, analyzes, and answers) is still conveyed, flagged as borderline below.
